summary.text: Timothy Becker is the Democratic candidate for Maine House of Representatives District 83 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
His campaign website describes a career as a tax attorney who now runs a solo law practice advising businesses on tax matters.

paragraphs.text: Becker writes on his campaign website that he grew up in a working-class neighborhood in Boston and put himself through college and three graduate programs.

After law school he worked as a tax attorney at Testa Hurwitz & Thibeault, Goodwin Procter, Akin Gump, where he made partner, and Choate Hall & Stewart, where he was a partner and built the tax group, and he also served as in-house tax counsel at AIG.
He says he now runs a solo law practice advising businesses on tax matters and invests in small businesses.
Becker advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.

His site lists economic development and jobs, child poverty, education and child care, property taxes, health care, broadband and infrastructure, and protecting lakes among his priorities for Bridgton, Denmark and Harrison.
